scope: Actual model (Blender/The_Commons_Compact.blend, unchanged since v0.9.0) with the v0.11.0 additions rebuilt by Blender/render_neon_views.py at the builders' dimensions: the kart neon dressing from Unity/Assets/TheCommons/Data/kart_neon_layout.json with CommonsKartNeonBuilder's primitives, transforms and colours, and the DISCO particle lasers as the particles alive at one moment of the built-in music (Data/music_score.json), simulated like CommonsLightingModes and drawn as stretched billboards. Kart views use the Standard view transform (no tone mapping, as Unity draws without a tonemapper); the cafe view keeps the file's AgX like 31-33. Not Unity/VRChat runtime captures: Unity lights the neon with baked GI and probes and renders the particles itself.
